about: The Board's phone speed budget (pass-app/SPEED.md). target = the goal (over it: a warning); hard = the limit (over it: fails the check once enforce is true). Frame numbers are JS work per frame on the throttled profile.

longFrames33.label: Scene frames over 33 ms (8 s busy)

zoomP95Ms.label: Frame work p95 during a pinch zoom

cityZoomP95Ms.label: Frame work p95 during a City pinch zoom (City home only)

flightP95Ms.label: Frame work p95 during a view change

firstUsefulPaintMs.label: First useful paint (status line, scene, first number)

heapMB.label: JS heap after the session (after a GC)

idleRafPerSec.label: Frame callbacks per second, calm Yard

idleScriptPct.label: Scripting, calm Yard (% of one core)
